utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Ira, what kind of repair help do you need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly just a hand getting the driveway patched up and maybe a quick look at the loose edging. If anyone’s got a shovel or some gravel to spare, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can bring a shovel and see if I’ve got any gravel left. What time do you want me over?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand with that repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus—if you’ve got any basic tools and maybe some gloves, that’d be a huge help. I’m still figuring out the rest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll bring a basic toolkit and some gloves. Just let me know where to meet up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping off tools and supplies there, which is really nice. I can check if they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be great, thanks — I just worry about what they still need and where to put things.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can swing by and ask them what’s still needed and where they want the next drop-offs. Then I’ll let you know so we don’t leave anything in the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam. Could you please pick up the repair kits from the community shed and bring them to the church basement by 3?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll pick up the repair kits from the community shed and bring them to the church basement by 3.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive already — if you want, I can pass your invite around too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. That’d be kind of you — I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll mention it to a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Leo — I’m keeping the repair drive list organized and should have an update for everyone soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, Rosa. Let me know if you need me to bring anything or help out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate that. I may ask you to help sort donations or set up a table, and I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details, just so I get them right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m pretty sure it’s the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday afternoon, and folks are bringing tools, spare parts, and anything small that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll go with Saturday afternoon, neighborhood repair drive, and people bringing tools, spare parts, and small repairs. If anything else comes up, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I’m trying to work around the school schedule for the repair drive. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Faye — I was thinking we could start around 3:30, after pickup, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 works for me after pickup. Thanks, Mara — I’ll plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn't heard the latest—what's the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s still on for Saturday morning at the community center, and we’ve got a decent list of tools and volunteers now. If you can swing by, we could still use an extra hand sorting donations.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks for the update—I can probably swing by Saturday and help sort donations. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help out a bit—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking—are you actually able to help with the repair drive, or should I plan on someone else too?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help out for sure—just keep it simple and tell me what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive’s happening soon—what do you need a hand with?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I could really use help sorting the tools and maybe carrying a few boxes. I keep misplacing things, so an extra pair of hands would be great.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help sort the tools and carry boxes. Just point me to where you want things set up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I'll mention the repair drive to the others and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Cleo — I’ll spread the word and check in with the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a decent turnout so far. I’m planning to swing by later and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard it’s been busy. I might stop by too if I have time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, maybe we’ll both find something small to help with. I’ll let you know if I hear they still need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm in, I just need to check what I can bring. Want me to spread the word to a few neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, please do—that would help a lot. I’ll spread the word too, and we can compare notes later.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, I’ll ask around today and let you know what folks can offer. Catch you later with my notes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, what’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s just a drop-off for tools and spare parts—leave what you can by Saturday afternoon at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks. I’ll see what tools and spare parts I can bring by Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over my tool box and whatever else might help with the repair drive. Just let me know what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s start with the tool box and a flashlight, and we can see what else we need after that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring the toolbox and a flashlight over, and we can figure out the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Quinn — I’m in for the repair drive. Let me know what you need me to bring or help with.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Mara — thank you! Could you bring a pair of work gloves and, if you have one, a screwdriver set?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring work gloves and a screwdriver set if I can find mine.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds great — I’m happy to help bridge the groups for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — could you help keep track of who’s picking up supplies and where we’re meeting? I’d like to keep everything organized for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can keep a running list of supplies and meeting spots, and I’ll share updates as things come in. Just send me the details as you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for bringing that up, Cleo — I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’m happy to go over what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rosa — can you tell me what’s still missing, and I’ll see what I can help round up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — we still need a few tool donations, some volunteer sign-up names, and a couple of spare tarps. If you can help round up any of those, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. Did you want to tell me what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—could you let me know what’s still missing and who’s handling it? I can help if there’s anything practical left to do.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together, but I can check with a couple people and see what’s left. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear who’s handling what.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—just give me the quick version of what you need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I just need help collecting and dropping off a few repair items for the drive, and I’m working around the school schedule. I can send you the details and timing if that works.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, send me the quick details and timing, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, can you confirm you’re actually coming by on Saturday? I just want to make sure before I count on you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m coming by on Saturday. You can count on me.
